thread:
sasha: Heads-up: deploybot is scheduled to run the coordinated rollout for API, runtime, console, and router at 02:00 UTC in the 2h change window. Please confirm pins and any hard dependencies.
corey: copying schedule. Which API schema version are we pinning?
sasha: pinning API -> v3.1.1, runtime -> r2026-03-23, router -> r1.14, console -> console-5.2. Small schema tweak in API (field rename email->contact_email). Need console to handle both keys for the canary.
deploybot: deploybot: kickoff queued for 1743223200 (02:00 UTC). Planned canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. Rollback hook: any 5xx spike > 2x baseline or p50 latency regression > 30% during a window triggers rollback.
ana: @sasha quick question — does runtime r2026-03-23 require a kernel flag flip? I saw a note about continuous-batching opt-in.
sasha: yes, runtime needs `--new-batching=true` for the improved latency profile. That flag is backward compatible but increases memory use; Dedicated customers with constrained nodes flagged earlier.
kevin: console team: we'll keep a compatibility layer. I'll add fallback for `email` if `contact_email` missing. I'll push a patch to canary branch now.
marie: noted; adding a short smoke test: auth + user-profile read + embedding route. If any fail we stop canary and revert.
corey: what's the exact pin command for ops? Put it here so deploybot picks it up.
sasha: use this:
```
rb pin api:v3.1.1 runtime:r2026-03-23 router:r1.14 console:console-5.2
```
Also update release notes: breaking change bullet and rollback criteria.
kevin: pushed console patch to `canary/compat-email`, smoke tests green locally. Deploybot: please delay canary by 5m to let caches warm, if possible.
deploybot: acknowledged. Canary delayed to 02:05 UTC. Will emit `deploybot` notifications at each stage.
corey: one more ask — add a soft-fallback policy on the router to route remaining traffic to runtime-old if latency > 800ms for 2 consecutive windows. Ops, are we comfortable with that?
sasha: yes, add fallback route to runtime-old with weight cap 20%. That should prevent full failover. Log the routing decision so we can audit.
marie: added smoke-run checklist and linked in the release notes. I also added a quick eval prompt set for the canary to check output formatting changes.
kevin: :thumbsup: from console side. I'm standing by during the window.
corey: I'll monitor traces and infra metrics. If p50 latency > 30% or error rate jumps we cut.
sasha: thanks everyone. If no objections by 01:45 UTC I'll execute the pin and trigger deploybot.
corey: no objections from infra.
kevin: none from console.
marie: all good.
deploybot: pin applied: api:v3.1.1 runtime:r2026-03-23 router:r1.14 console:console-5.2. Canary started at 1743223500 (02:05 UTC).
